maintenance.title: Workspace data
maintenance.policy: Command logs are kept for 30 days. Removed workspace data can be reattached within 30 days. Old snapshots keep the latest 5, with a 30-day window and a maximum of 40. App updates do not reset these dates.
maintenance.mismatch: The selected folder could not be verified as the original. Use Add workspace to add it as a new workspace. The old association and data are retained.
maintenance.unavailable: The original folder is unavailable. It may have moved or be temporarily disconnected.
maintenance.confirmLogs: Permanently delete saved command logs for this workspace. Project files are unaffected.
maintenance.confirmSnapshots: Permanently delete old checkpoints and their recovery contents. Current project files, chats and Island changes are unaffected.
maintenance.confirmAll: Permanently delete this workspace's launch settings, logs and old checkpoints. This cannot be undone. Project files and chats are unaffected.

title: Legacy workspace data migration
scope: Move launch configurations, checkpoint history and command logs from workspace .janusX folders to the JanusX application data location below.
cleanup: Verified legacy files are removed after migration succeeds. Project source, unrecognized files and Hook assets stay in place. The .janusX directory is removed only when empty.
retention: Time-based retention restarts once at the first successful migration. Original creation dates are preserved. Retries and later ordinary upgrades do not restart it again.
closeTasks: Close terminals and running tasks in the selected workspaces and their subdirectories, and exit older JanusX versions still using these folders before migrating.
noPending: No workspaces awaiting migration. Reconnect offline workspaces or resolve errors, then check again.

status.cleanup-pending: Using new storage; legacy cleanup incomplete
status.unsupported: Migration required in the workspace environment
